name: a one-line pitch lands beside three ways to start
looks: A bold line states the new, cheap way in; a quieter grey line underneath promises no recurring cost. Below both, three small pill buttons fan in together, each naming a different way to begin (a file upload, a spreadsheet drop, a domain scan).
build: The first line lands at full weight; the second, muted line arrives a beat after it without dimming the first (list-stack-reveal's rhythm, reversed emphasis). The three pills pop in with a 10-30% uneven stagger on a spring ease, each a slightly different size as its label demands.
sound: A soft tick as each headline line lands, a light cluster of three clicks as the pills arrive.
prompt: Pair a confident one-line pitch with a quieter promise underneath it (no subscription, no catch), then fan in three small pill buttons beneath both, each naming a different, equally easy way to get started. Keep the pills' entrance staggered and uneven so it reads as a real set of options, not one template repeated.
